qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Low-cost Paso de los Toros eucalyptus pulp mill in Uruguay and Nordic hydropower/forest assets offer scale advantages, but UPM remains an unhedged price-taker in global commodity pulp and declining graphic paper. ROCE dropped to 3.5% in 2023, 4.1% in 2024, and 5.5% in 2025, falling far below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% and lack of pricing power, REJECT). Finnish forestry and pulp group is exposed to secular volume contraction in graphic paper and severe cyclicality in commodity market pulp, with multi-cycle ROCE of 3.5-5.5% over 2023-2025 failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: ROCE fell from 12.8% in 2022 to 3.5% in 2023, 4.1% in 2024, and 5.5% in 2025 (5-year median ~5.0%, far below 12%). Net debt rose to €3.0B following massive capital investment in the Uruguay pulp mill and Leuna biochemical refinery overruns, while graphic paper demand experiences persistent secular decline.
